# DGII fixtures

This directory holds fixtures for DGII-related mapping and (future) XML tests.

## Rules

- Official DGII certification test-set Excel/XML files must **not** be invented.
- Only sanitized fixtures belong here.
- Future fixtures must be either:
  - traceable to official DGII certification test sets, or
  - clearly marked **synthetic / not official / not DGII-compliant**.

## Current contents

- `synthetic_invoice_mapping_case.json` — synthetic internal mapping case only.
- `synthetic_certification_case.json` — synthetic local harness smoke case only.
